Package com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces

Class CompatNamespace

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces.CompatNamespace
public class CompatNamespace extends Object
REST namespace for compatibility (CXML/Twilio-compatible) resources.

The Twilio-compatible LAML API is mounted under /api/laml/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}. The trailing /api prefix is added by HttpClient, so namespace base paths here begin with /laml/2010-04-01/Accounts/....
